query:
SELECT c.blob_sha256, c.mime
        FROM covers c
        WHERE c.id = $1
          AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tracks t WHERE t.id = c.track_id)
               OR EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM album_tracks at
                   JOIN tracks t ON t.id = at.track_id
                   WHERE at.album_id = c.album_id
               ))
